q: Who is credited with inventing the first computer?
exp: Charles Babbage is credited with inventing the first computer.

q: What was the name of the first commercial computer?
exp: UNIVAC 1 was the first commercial computer.

q: Who developed the first electronic computer?
exp: John Mauchly and Presper Eckert developed the first electronic computer.

q: What was the first computer programming language?
exp: Machine Code was the first computer programming language.

q: Who developed the first high-level programming language?
exp: John Backus developed the first high-level programming language.

q: What was the name of the first computer that used a stored-program concept?
exp: EDVAC was the first computer that used a stored-program concept.

q: Who developed the first computer with a magnetic drum memory?
exp: John Atanasoff developed the first computer with a magnetic drum memory.

q: What was the name of the first computer with a commercial success?
exp: UNIVAC 1 was the first computer with a commercial success.

q: Who is credited with developing the first computer with a graphical user interface?
exp: Douglas Engelbart is credited with developing the first computer with a graphical user interface.

q: What was the name of the first computer that used a keyboard as the primary input device?
exp: ENIAC was the first computer that used a keyboard as the primary input device.

q: Who developed the first computer that used a vacuum tube?
exp: John Mauchly developed the first computer that used a vacuum tube.

q: What was the name of the first computer that used a transistor?
exp: UNIVAC 1 was the first computer that used a transistor.

q: Who developed the first computer with a floppy disk drive?
exp: John Mauchly developed the first computer with a floppy disk drive.

q: What was the name of the first computer that used a mouse as an input device?
exp: ENIAC was the first computer that used a mouse as an input device.

q: Who developed the first computer with a touch screen interface?
exp: Douglas Engelbart developed the first computer with a touch screen interface.

q: What was the name of the first computer that used a CD-ROM drive?
exp: UNIVAC 1 was the first computer that used a CD-ROM drive.
